SET 1/6

Pause
Normal
PRIMARY
Pectorals
SECONDARY
Triceps, Anterior Deltoids

Instructions

Preparation: Lie on the bench with both feet planted and shoulder blades set. Grip the bar just outside shoulders and unrack before the shown cycle.

1

Shoulder blades set; feet stay planted.

2

Bend elbows; keep wrists over elbows.

3

Lower smoothly toward the mid-chest.

4

Touch lightly; keep the neck clear.

5

Press upward and back toward shoulders.

6

Straight arms; hips remain on bench.

Watch out

Flared elbows (straight out at 90°) are how shoulders get wrecked. If you can't hold the 45° tuck, drop weight and fix the groove.

COMMON MISTAKES

Flaring the elbows to 90° instead of a ~45° tuck.
Bouncing the bar off the chest instead of a controlled touch.
Letting the hips lift off the bench to grind a rep.
